systems.country_label: plateforme « Porte Educ » du ministère de l'Éducation nationale

note: Higher-education item, outside the study's levels: a workshop to register the 2025 baccalauréat holders with a unique university identifier, and the announced SIGU university management system (with SIGOU, ANSAE and CENOU KIBARU). The one school-sector system is 'Porte Educ', named only as a platform SIGU is to be interconnected with, with no description of what it does, so it is unclassified.
